viewing_check: Look for a 375 or 9ct stamp on the bolt ring or clasp tag. Weigh it if possible (decides value, about A$55-60/g for solid). Test whether links are hollow or gold-filled/rolled gold (reddish colour is a warning); acid test or magnet if allowed.
